title: Add benchmark-lab multi-variant reporting pipeline v60
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Motivation: consolidate multi-variant profiling and reporting into a single, reproducible pipeline (v60) to reduce pipeline divergence and improve comparability across benchmark runs. This PR adds a DAG that orchestrates representative workload runners, profiling baselines collection, metric aggregation and S3 artifact export.

What changed: added a new pipeline definition, a lightweight multi-variant runner wrapper, improved metrics exporter, and docs for the new reporting format. The pipeline supports per-variant metadata, artifact versioning, and incremental uploads when a run is restarted.

Checklist:
- [x] Add pipeline YAML and orchestration code
- [x] Implement metrics exporter and aggregated report generator
- [x] Add unit tests for runner and exporter components
- [x] CI integration and e2e smoke test
- [x] Docs and runbook for troubleshooting

Testing: Local unit tests + CI smoke run against a small synthetic workload. CI failed on first run due to linting in multi_variant_runner (fixed in second commit). End-to-end staging run executed and uploaded artifacts to staging S3 prefix; manually validated aggregated JSON schema and CSV summary.

Rollout / migration notes: v60 is additive and does not change existing v59 pipelines. New pipeline is wired behind a feature flag (benchmark_lab.reporting_v60) in the CI job to enable staged rollout. If any downstream consumers require the old CSV layout, use the compatibility exporter (included) or pin to v59.

Related work: ENG-4321 (consolidate reporting pipelines), ENG-4389 (profiling baseline v60), references existing reporting v59 PRs for migration guidance.

release_notes: Add v60 benchmark-lab reporting pipeline: multi-variant orchestration, aggregated metrics exporter, and S3 artifact uploads. Backwards-compatible with v59; feature-flagged rollout.
